title: 第十三章 西北局势第十四章 又来一个未婚妻
content_zh:
翌日，送走了赶来道谢兼送礼的普宁县众武林人士，方少白陪着卸去了伪装的王昱三人在客栈大厅吃早饭。
“赵兄原来还没我大！”方少白终于看到了王昱的真面目，但对王昱却更佩服了。
如此年纪，就能说出那么有道理的话，甚至能够指点自己，将自己从某种意义上的心境歪路上拉回来，这可不是一般人能做到的事。
这么说吧，整个太华派能够指点自己的人也没几个！
林知远和魏岩也在场，看向王昱三人的目光诧异中带着震惊，没想到他们就是传说中的镇西王赵昱和女状元李云岫。
这两位武功未必有多高，但名声却是真不小。
“我们刚才还看到南山双杰江氏兄弟了。”林知远说道，“他们还想来说服师兄，让师兄将赵……王爷和王妃交给他们，被我和魏师弟挡回去了。”
“人在江湖，不要称官职。”王昱提醒道。
众人闻言大笑。
“果然是三人成虎，传言害人，赵兄明明风趣幽默，怎么就被传成了性格乖张，嚣张跋扈？”魏岩感慨道。
“那要看我面对的是谁。”王昱嘿嘿笑道，“若是那位大金刚寺的宏照和尚提起我，估计不会有什么好话。”
已经知道昨夜发生了什么的林知远和魏岩再次大笑。
方少白看向王昱，还是略显担心，“那易筋锻骨丹，的确是大金刚寺的秘传丹药，专门用以配合修行大金刚寺的镇寺神功《金刚龙象功》，你昨天就这么吞了，真的没事吗？”
“没事！”王昱摆手，“那和尚危言耸听，我吃了丹药，感觉经脉更坚韧了，骨骼更坚硬了，都是好处，哪儿来的害处？”
“那就好。”方少白放下心来，“左右你那镇西王府也不缺钱不缺药，真有问题也不怕。”
说到这里，方少白也不由嘿嘿笑道，“易筋锻骨丹主药难寻，既要纯阳熊虎之骨，又要百年山参和黄精，大金刚寺几年都未必能开一炉，如今被你吞了一颗，他们可是要心疼了。”
太华派和大金刚寺都在河西道，而且还是邻居，虽说都是名门大派，日常见面也是商业互吹，但若说一点龃龉都没有，那也是不可能的。
没了一颗易筋锻骨丹，大金刚寺力量必然削弱一分，太华派自然乐见其成，方少白虽然一向专心练武，从不参与这些勾心斗角，但却也不是什么都不知道。
林知远提醒道，“赵兄想要回镇西王府，无论走哪条路，都是要经过大兴府的。”
方少白大早上就让店伙给自己温了一壶黄酒，此时抿了一口，细细品尝，“我陪着赵兄一起回陇山府，倒要看看大金刚寺的宗善大师会不会亲自拦路。”

林知远嘴角一抽，“那不至于！”
宗善大师乃是大金刚寺住持，天下有名的武道宗师，论辈分比他们太华派的掌门还要高半辈，无论如何做不出亲自出手阻拦王昱前往王府就任的事。
……
然后他们就上路了。
既然恢复身份，于是王昱把牛车也卖了，换了一辆马车，虽然比不上前一辆宽敞奢华，但也比牛车舒服多了，而且速度也快多了。
李云岫和紫菱坐在车里，王昱和方少白坐在车外。
离开普宁县时，方少白还跟王昱指了指城外树林边藏头露尾的两个人，一个金刀客段平，一个铁掌开山孟崇虎。
不过这两人在看到方少白对他们指指点点之后，立刻就钻到了树林里，消失不见了。
“想不到镇西王府和大金刚寺还有矛盾。”王昱想了想问道，“大金刚寺的高手，应该比镇西王府多吧？”
“大金刚寺和般若禅寺一西一东，号称佛门两宗，高手当然多。”方少白理所当然的道，“但是镇西王府有朝廷明令节制三府，而且还有五万大军，大金刚寺吃多了敢去攻击王府？”
王昱撇撇嘴，“但宏照和尚就敢拿我。”
方少白嘿嘿笑道，“谁让你们当时落单，他们当然不敢杀你，但是把你请到大金刚寺，让你签订城下之盟，那他们便宜就占大了，须知镇西王府也不敢轻易针对大金刚寺的。”
镇西王府虽然有五万大军，但大金刚寺高手多呀，谁也不想半夜睡觉总是睁着一只眼睛。
王昱回头看向车里，“那你之前还敢带着我走这条路？”
李云岫淡淡的道，“之前咱们是带着一队皇城禁卫的，大金刚寺是名门正派，绝不会冲击朝廷卫队。”
王昱，“……”
王昱叹了口气，“我在京城待了十年，对西北的局势实在不清楚，除了大金刚寺和太华派，西北还有什么势力吗？”
“说到点子上了。”方少白拍手笑道，“大金刚寺毕竟是名门正派，还要面子，祁山巨寇可是一点面子都不要的。”
“祁山巨寇？”
content_en:
The next day, after seeing off all the martial arts figures from Puning County who came to express their gratitude and give gifts, Fang Shaobai accompanied Wang Yu and the other two men, who had taken off their disguises, to have breakfast in the inn lobby.
"Brother Zhao turns out to be not older than me!" Fang Shaobai finally saw Wang Yu's true face, but he admired Wang Yu even more.
At such an age, being able to say such reasonable things, and even being able to guide oneself and pull oneself back from a certain mental state, is not something that ordinary people can do.
Let's put it this way, there are only a few people in the entire Taihua sect who can point them out!
Lin Zhiyuan and Wei Yan were also present. They looked at Wang Yu and the others with surprise and shock. They did not expect that they were the legendary Zhenxi King Zhao Yu and the female champion Li Yunxiu.
These two martial arts may not be very high, but their reputations are really quite big.
"We just saw the Nanshan Shuangjie Jiang brothers." Lin Zhiyuan said, "They also wanted to persuade senior brother to hand over Zhao...Prince and Princess to them, but Junior Brother Wei and I blocked them back."
"When you are in the Jianghu, don't claim to be an official." Wang Yu reminded.
Everyone laughed when they heard this.
"Sure enough, three people are like a tiger. Rumors can harm people. Brother Zhao is obviously funny and humorous, but why is he rumored to have a perverse personality and be arrogant and domineering?" Wei Yan said with emotion.
"It depends on who I face." Wang Yu chuckled, "If that Monk Hongzhao from the Great Vajra Temple mentions me, he probably won't have anything nice to say."
Lin Zhiyuan and Wei Yan, who already knew what happened last night, laughed again.
Fang Shaobai looked at Wang Yu, still slightly worried, "The Yijinguangguangdan is indeed the secret elixir of the Great Vajra Temple. It is specially used to cooperate with the practice of the temple-destroying magic "Vajra Dragon Elephant Exercise" of the Great Vajra Temple. You just swallowed it yesterday. Are you really okay?"
"It's okay!" Wang Yu waved his hand, "That monk is being alarmist. I took the elixir and felt that my meridians were tougher and my bones were stronger. These are all benefits. Where are the harms?"
"That's good." Fang Shaobai felt relieved, "Your Zhenxi Prince's Mansion is not short of money or medicine, so if there is a problem, it's not afraid."
Speaking of this, Fang Shaobai couldn't help but chuckle and said, "The main ingredient of the Yijin Bone Strengthening Pill is hard to find. It requires both pure Yang bear and tiger bones, and century-old mountain ginseng and Polygonatum japonica. The Great Vajra Temple may not be able to open a furnace in several years. Now that you have swallowed one, they will be heartbroken."
The Taihua Sect and the Great Vajra Temple are both located on Hexi Road, and they are neighbors. Although they are both famous sects, and their daily meetings are business exchanges, it is impossible to say that there is no discord at all.
Without the Bone-Easing Pill, the power of the Great Vajra Temple will inevitably be weakened. The Taihua Sect is naturally happy to see this happen. Although Fang Shaobai has always concentrated on martial arts training and never participated in these intrigues, he does not know everything.
Lin Zhiyuan reminded, "Brother Zhao wants to go back to Zhenxi Prince's Mansion. No matter which way he takes, he has to pass through Daxing Mansion."
Fang Shaobai asked the shopkeeper to warm a pot of rice wine for him early in the morning. He took a sip and tasted it carefully, "I will accompany Brother Zhao back to Longshan Mansion, but I want to see if Master Zongshan of the Great Vajra Temple will personally block the way."
Lin Zhiyuan's mouth twitched, "That's not the case!"
Master Zongshan is the abbot of the Great Vajra Temple and a world-famous martial arts master. In terms of seniority, he is half a generation older than the head of their Taihua Sect. There is nothing he can do to personally prevent Wang Yu from going to the palace to take up his post.
…
Then they were on their way.
Now that his identity was restored, Wang Yu sold the ox-cart and replaced it with a horse-drawn carriage. Although it was not as spacious and luxurious as the previous one, it was much more comfortable and faster than the ox-cart.
Li Yunxiu and Zi Ling were sitting in the car, while Wang Yu and Fang Shaobai were sitting outside the car.
When leaving Puning County, Fang Shaobai pointed out to Wang Yu two people hiding in the woods outside the city, Duan Ping, the golden swordsman, and Meng Chonghu, the iron palm master.
But after seeing Fang Shaobai pointing at them, the two people immediately got into the woods.Here, disappeared.
"I didn't expect that the Zhenxi Prince's Palace and the Great Vajra Temple would still have conflicts." Wang Yu thought for a while and asked, "There should be more masters in the Great Vajra Temple than the Zhenxi Prince's Palace, right?"
"The Great Vajra Temple and the Prajna Zen Temple are located in the west and the east. They are known as the two sects of Buddhism. Of course there are many masters." Fang Shaobai said matter-of-factly, "But the Zhenxi Prince's Palace has an official order from the imperial court to control the three palaces, and there are 50,000 troops. If the Great Vajra Temple eats too much, dare to attack the palace?"
Wang Yu curled his lips, "But Monk Hongzhao dared to attack me."
Fang Shaobai chuckled and said, "Who told you to be alone at that time? Of course they wouldn't dare to kill you, but if they invite you to the Great Vajra Temple and ask you to sign an alliance under the city, then they will take advantage. It should be noted that Zhenxi Prince's Palace does not dare to target the Great Vajra Temple easily."
Although there are 50,000 troops in the Zhenxi Palace, there are so many masters in the Great Vajra Temple that no one wants to sleep with one eye open in the middle of the night.
Wang Yu looked back at the car, "Then you still dared to take me on this road before?"
Li Yunxiu said calmly, "We brought a group of imperial guards before. The Great Vajra Temple is a well-known and upright sect and will never attack the imperial guards."
Wang Yu, "..."
Wang Yu sighed, "I have been in the capital for ten years, and I really don't know much about the situation in the northwest. Apart from the Great Vajra Temple and the Taihua Sect, are there any other forces in the northwest?"
"That's the point." Fang Shaobai clapped his hands and said with a smile, "The Great Vajra Temple is a well-known and upright sect after all, and it wants face. The Qishan giant bandits don't want any face at all."
"Qishan Giant Bandit?"
